newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle fairly active at $72 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle fairly active at $72 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was fairly active, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher, according to USDA. Inquiry and demand good.

Sales confirmed on 5,300 slaughter steers and 3,500 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 124,100 head confirmed including 17,400 head or about 14 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1350 lbs 72.00, small pen 71.50.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 72.00, small pen 71.50; pen Commercial to Choice 1200 lb heiferettes 69.00.
wk to date - 124,100 last week - 18,600 last year - 49,800
